jobs.occupation: Microsoft D365 Business Central: Functional Consultant
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Business Central professional who thrives on transforming businesses through innovative technology solutions? If working in a dynamic international company sounds like your ideal next challenge, then this opportunity is made for you!

We are currently looking for a skilled and motivated colleague to join our Professional Services Department as a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central Consultant.

Your Responsibilities

• 
Manage and build strong relationships with our customers, acting as a trusted advisor throughout their journey

• 
Lead and contribute to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and TravelOperations implementation projects for customers across the globe

• 
Take ownership of and drive various workstreams during those implementation projects, ensuring successful delivery and customer satisfaction

• 
Provide ongoing support, consultancy, and continuous improvement recommendations to customers after Go Live, helping them maximize the value of their solutions

• 
Collaborate with our Product Department by sharing customer insights, feedback, and functional expertise to support the continued development of our solutions

Desired Skills & Requirements

Different profiles can be relevant, but the ideal candidate has the following competencies:

• 
Solid hands-on functional experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, with the ability to confidently advise customers and translate business requirements into effective solutions

• 
Experience participating in or leading Business Central/NAV implementation projects, preferably in an international environment

• 
Experience within the travel industry is an advantage but not a requirement

• 
Proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of working independently while taking ownership of your responsibilities

• 
Strong consulting, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken

• 
Enjoys working in an international environment and is open to occasional travel as part of the role

What awaits you?

• 
Enjoy real influence in a fast-growing company where execution, growth, and efficiency are core values

• 
Join a leading Microsoft technology company helping global travel businesses transform and scale

• 
Be part of an international organization with colleagues across Europe, North America, Asia, and Australia

• 
Contribute to delivering innovative Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and TravelOperations solutions to travel companies worldwide, combining industry expertise with modern technology

• 
Benefit from a flexible working environment

• 
Join a strong, collaborative culture where people enjoy working together and building something meaningful

The role is based at one of our offices in Copenhagen, Aalborg, Halmstad, or Brisbane (Australia).

How to Apply

For more details, please contact, HR Manager, Nicholas Poulsen, at nop@traveloperations.com or

visit our careers site at www.traveloperations.com.

We can't wait to hear from you!

About Travel Operations A/S

At TravelOperations, we're not just about professionalism and ambition; we're about building an environment where every employee shines. Our global reach spans from Greenland to Australia, as we partner with leading travel agencies, airlines, and leisure-focused businesses to craft tailor-made solutions. Join us in reshaping the travel industry landscape, where responsiveness and innovation are our guiding stars.

Diversity and Inclusion

At our company, Diversity and Inclusion are core values. We welcome applicants of all genders, striving for a workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered. Join us in building an inclusive future where diversity is celebrated as a strength.

jobs.occupation: Grow365.io is Hiring an Ambitious Account Manager for the UK Market
jobs.description:
Join Grow365.io on an exciting digital growth journey

Grow365.io is a fast-growing software company helping B2B businesses generate new customers and enter new markets through AI and automation software.

We already work with companies such as Jyllands-Posten, Kingspan, JKS and many others. We are now looking for an ambitious Account Manager to help strengthen our presence in the UK market.

You will become part of a young, energetic team based in Aarhus, Denmark, where sales, advisory and high performance go hand in hand.

About the role

As Account Manager, you will be responsible for the full sales process in the UK market – from the first contact to closing the deal.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Prospecting through phone, email, LinkedIn and Grow365.io

• 
Booking and conducting online meetings with potential customers

• 
Understanding customer needs and advising them on relevant solutions

• 
Following up with prospects and closing deals

• 
Building and maintaining strong customer relationships

• 
Working closely with management and the sales team

What we offer

At Grow365.io, you will have the opportunity to build a strong international sales career in a company with high ambitions and significant growth potential.

We offer:

• 
Competitive base salary combined with an attractive commission scheme

• 
Uncapped earning potential

• 
Strong professional and personal development opportunities

• 
Thorough onboarding and training

• 
Professional equipment

• 
An ambitious and supportive working environment

• 
A varied role in a fast-growing software company

• 
Regular social and professional events

Who are you?

We are looking for someone with energy, drive and a strong desire to achieve results. You enjoy speaking with customers, building relationships and working towards clear targets.

We particularly value that you:

• 
Are confident and persuasive on the phone

• 
Can build trust quickly with potential customers

• 
Work independently and in a structured way

• 
Are comfortable making a high volume of calls

• 
Are motivated by targets, results and performance

• 
Take responsibility and follow through on your tasks

• 
Speak and write English fluently

Previous sales experience is an advantage, but not a requirement. The most important thing is your attitude, motivation and willingness to learn and develop.

Practical information

The position is based in Aarhus, Denmark, and focuses on the UK market.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact CEO Mads Thomsen on +45 50 42 04 78.

Please send your application to mads@grow365.io.

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.occupation: Welders Wanted at Lomac A/S  / Svejsere søges til Lomac A/S
jobs.description:
In English:About Lomac A/SLomac A/S is a Danish manufacturing company specializing in steel constructions, working within areas such as marine, offshore, construction, and wind turbines. We currently have 50–60 employees, and due to a strong order intake and exciting customer projects, we need more skilled welders for our production.We already have international employees on our team, so we know what it takes to give new international colleagues a good start — both professionally and socially.We offer
• Permanent position in a well-established and solid company
• Modern machinery and good working conditions
• Training and hands-on onboarding at the start
• Free accommodation in a single room during your work periods in Denmark.
• A working environment with experienced and dedicated colleagues
• Opportunities for professional and personal developmentJob content
• MIG/MAG welding of steel constructions for marine, offshore, construction, and wind turbine projects, among others
• Reading technical drawings and working according to work instructions
• Quality control of your own work
• Collaborating with other production staff to meet delivery deadlinesWe expect that you
• Are a qualified welder or have documented experience as a welder
• Hold a valid welding certificate 136/138 H-LO45 D168, or equivalent documented qualification
• Are reliable, punctual, and take a professional approach to the work
• Can work independently and as part of a team
• Are quality-conscious and detail-orientedRequirements for applicants
• Are a citizen of an EU/EEA country, or already hold a valid Danish work permit
• Can communicate in English and/or German
• Are willing to work in Denmark for set periods at a time (rotation scheme – see Terms of Employment below)Terms of employment
• Number of positions: 10–15
• Start date: As soon as possible
• Employment type: Permanent position
• Working model: Rotation scheme – employees work a set period in Denmark, followed by a period at home, before returning to Denmark. The preferred rotation is 4 weeks of work followed by 2 weeks off. Travel to and from Denmark is at the employee’s own expense.
• Working hours: 6–7 days a week x 10.5 hours – day and night shifts
• Hourly pay: DKK 180/200 (approximately EUR 24/27) per hour
• Overtime: We follow the current overtime pay rules of the Confederation of Danish Industry
• Employee benefits: Housing and work clothing is provided
• Collective agreement: Employment conditions are based on the applicable Collective agreement with the Confederation of Danish Industry (DI).Contact personJonas Nielsen, Business CoordinatorLomac A/SEmail: jni@lomac.dkPhone: +45 42 13 39 02How to applySend your application and CV to jni@lomac.dk As soon as possible.Please write "Welder – Application" in the subject line.In Danish:

jobs.occupation: Technical Sales Support Engineer to EYKON, Denmark or Mälardalen, Sweden
jobs.description: EYKON operates as an independent utility infrastructure technology company built on more than 130 years of utility expertise. Headquartered in Switzerland, with a network of expert local teams, the company serves customers in more than 75 markets and supports over 100 million connected endpoints across the region.Combining proven metering technology, deep utility expertise and real-world operational insight from one of the largest installed bases in EMEA, EYKON connects what utilities measure with how they operate. This helps customers gain greater visibility, make better decisions, maintain greater control and unlock more value from the infrastructure they already operate.Do you want to play a key role in the green energy transition while working in the intersection of technology, customer support and commercial development?EYKON is looking for a Technical Sales Support Engineer to support customers and sales activities across Scandinavia. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, coordinating stakeholders and solving a wide variety of customer and business challenges in an international environment.In this role, you will become a central part of the Scandinavian organisation. Acting as the link between customers, sales teams, product management and technical specialists, you will help ensure that customers receive the right support while contributing to the continued growth of the business across Denmark, Sweden and Norway.The RoleAs Technical Sales Support Engineer, you will support Scandinavian customers and the Nordic Sales organisation across EYKON's portfolio of hardware, software and service solutions. The role combines customer support, pre-sales, order management and stakeholder coordination in a truly international environment.Your responsibilities will include:    Supporting customers across Denmark, Sweden and Norway.    Coordinating customer-related activities and acting as the customer's internal ambassador.    Working in close cooperations with order management team     Following up on logistics, deliveries and customer commitments.    Providing technical and commercial support to the sales organisation    Supporting tenders, RFQs and commercial projects.    Participating in pre-sales initiatives and customer-facing activities.    Conducting customer, market and competitor analysis.    Coordinating activities between customers and internal specialists.    Supporting customer training, product documentation and knowledge transfer together with Training team och Product Management.This is a highly collaborative role where your ability to build relationships and navigate different stakeholder groups will be just as important as your technical understanding. You will work closely with experienced specialists while gradually developing extensive knowledge of EYKON's products, solutions and customers.The preferred location is Sorø, Denmark, but strong candidates located in Sweden, particularly in the Örebro/Mälardalen region, will also be considered. Travel within Scandinavia is included in the role.Is this you?To be successful in this role, you have experience from a customer-facing B2B environment involving technical sales, customer support, sales support, application support, pre-sales or similar technical-commercial responsibilities. You are comfortable working with technical products, systems or solutions and enjoy building strong relationships with both customers and internal stakeholders. Experience coordinating activities across multiple functions and stakeholders is important, as is the ability to support quotations, tenders and customer-related projects. You understand how hardware, software and services interact within a broader solution environment and are able to translate technical topics into practical customer value. Professional proficiency in English together with Swedish and/or Danish language skills is required in the role, as the position involves daily collaboration with colleagues and customers across Sweden, Denmark and Norway.Experience from the energy sector, utilities, smart metering, infrastructure, automation or related technical industries is considered an advantage, but we welcome candidates from a broad range of technical and technical-commercial environments. The most important factor is your ability to learn, build relationships and create value for customers.In this recruitment, your personal qualities will be of great importance. We are looking for a proactive, structured and customer-focused person who enjoys taking ownership and driving activities forward. You are curious, eager to learn and comfortable operating in the intersection between commercial and technical discussions. As a person, you enjoy creating structure, coordinating stakeholders and ensuring that things get done. You thrive in collaborative environments and are motivated by building relationships, solving problems and supporting both customers and colleagues.Do you want to know more?I In this process EYKON is working with Level Recruitment. To apply, please click the apply button. If you have further questions don´t hesitate to contact senior recruitment consultant Stina Koskijev at +46735588921, or stina.koskijev@levelrecruitment.se. Please note, no applications are allowed on email. Please highlight your key skills and industry experience.We will interview ongoingly so please register your application as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Chief Accountant to Schneider Electric- Copenhagen
jobs.description: Mpya Finance is recruiting a Chief Accountant to Schneider Electric in Copenhagen – a key role for you who want to combine technical accounting expertise with impact, development and an international context.If you are looking to advance your career, this is your opportunity to take the next step and develop together with Schneider.At Schneider Electric, sustainability, innovation and performance go hand in hand. This is an opportunity to become a trusted financial partner in an organization that is actively shaping the future of energy.About the roleAs Chief Accountant, you will play a central role in ensuring high-quality financial reporting and compliance across the Nordic and Baltic entities, working closely with the global Shared Service Center in India. You will be part of a strong, international finance organization where collaboration, continuous improvement and professional development are highly valued.The role offers both responsibility and variety – from statutory reporting and balance sheet ownership to process improvements and cross-border collaboration.Your main responsibilities:    Ensure high quality and accuracy in financial reporting    Lead monthly and quarterly closings in accordance with IFRS and local GAAP    Full responsibility for balance sheet accuracy and reviews    Ownership of annual reports, income tax returns and tax reporting    Lead Balance Sheet Review meetings and collaborate with key stakeholders    Coordinate and drive external audits for assigned legal entities    Drive simplification, standardization and continuous improvement of accounting processes    Participate in finance projects, system improvements and ad hoc analysesWho are we looking for?To succeed in this role, we believe you have a solid accounting foundation and the confidence to take ownership in a complex, international environment.We are looking for someone who has:• A degree in Accounting, Finance or equivalent• At least 3 years of experience working with Danish accounting, preferably in a global organization• Experience working with a Shared Service Center (meritorious)• Strong skills in SAP (or similar), Excel and other MS tools• Fluency in Danish and English, both written and spokenAs a person, you are structured, methodical, and quality-driven. You take ownership of your responsibilities, work proactively, and thrive in a complex international environment. At the same time, you are a true team player who enjoys collaborating closely with colleagues and stakeholders across functions and geographies.We believe that success in this role comes from balancing strong individual accountability with a collaborative mindset. You build trust easily, communicate clearly, and actively contribute to the team's results and development. You enjoy sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues, and working together to achieve common goals.What Schneider Electric offersAt Schneider Electric, you will join a globally recognized company with a strong commitment to sustainability, innovation and people development. Do you want to contribute to protecting energy systems of the future and secure OT infrastructure in Renewable Energy? Then apply to become part of an international and market-leading asset management consultancy within the renewable energy industry. PEAK Wind is looking for a Cyber Security Consultant, who wants to take their cyber security career to the next level and is looking to work on a diverse and exciting portfolio within wind power and other renewable Energy sources.Trusted Advisors for Developers and Investors for some of the Largest Renewable AssetsAt PEAK Wind, we specialise in operations, asset management, and project management of Renewable Energy assets and take pride in providing best-in-class commercial, financial, and operational advisory and support to our clients. We work with some of the world’s largest infrastructure investments and are proud to count market-leading utilities, investment funds, and independent power producers among our clients.Job Content, Responsibilities, and Possibilities:Based in one of our offices in Denmark (Aarhus and Copenhagen), or Germany (Hamburg) you will be working in a team supporting customer projects and programs within the field of IT/OT and cyber security. We are a dedicated team of mixed seniorities and nationalities with a collaborative working environment. SCADA and Cyber Security is a crucial area for our clients, who we support on both greenfield and brownfield projects. The team works across disciplines, ensuring seamless integration, operation, and cyber security of OT, ICS, and SCADA systems.Your responsibilities include:- Leading risk assessments of IT/OT environments for clients across large-scale renewable assets, and providing risk mitigation strategies and recommendations.- Developing IT/OT operating models, guidelines, and procedures for renewable assets.- Developing and communicating IT/OT infrastructure designs to our customers.- Implementing cyber security solutions for IT and OT environments on large-scale renewable assets, and reporting to project management, customers directly, and/or other senior engineering functions.- Adapt to legislation and regulatory requirements for the IT/OT environment. Advise on the utilisation of best practices, policies, and standards, such as IEC62443, and ISO27000.- Build strong relationships with stakeholders, in PEAK Wind and among our customers.What you Bring and your QualitiesWe expect that you have a minimum of 2-4 years of experience from a similar position, and previous experience with cyber security functions, such as Risk Management, Vulnerability Assessments, and Security Assessments. Furthermore, experience within security systems including firewalls and security engineering is required. Recognized security certification is desirable and experience with implementation of national standards such as NERC/CIP or NIS2 would be considered an advantage. The ideal candidate would have experience with renewable energy projects and/or implementation of Cyber Security Management Systems in other industries.As a person, you are a team player, and you thrive working in an international and diverse team with mixed cultures and seniorities. You are detail-oriented and possess strong problem-solving skills in IT/OT systems. As PEAK Wind is a global company, you must also have strong English communication skills, both oral and written. Finally, we are looking for a candidate with excellent stakeholder management skills.Experience the Highest Degree of InvolvementPEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity and our values of Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity are materialized through our team members every day. Here you will be able to utilize your financial skills while developing a strong understanding of renewable energy assets. We offer an opportunity to get on board and experience the highest degree of involvement and responsibility in PEAK Wind’s global renewable energy team. Together with the rest of the team, you will play an instrumental part in the continued success of PEAK Wind. Above that, you will participate in an entrepreneurial environment, with a focus on cooperation and a desire to change the status quo. The position will also offer global exposure as our clients work globally.Interested and want to know more?If you have any questions or want to know more about the position, please contact People & Development via recruitment@peak-wind.com (recruitment@peak-wind.com) . We look forward to receiving your applications & CVs as soon as possible. Please apply through ‘Apply’ at the bottom of the page. Applications will be assessed on an ongoing basis.PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.
